criteria.criterion: A failing worker reports which inner git command failed.
A failing worker reports git's stdout as well as its stderr, so an empty-stderr failure such as 'nothing to commit' is diagnosable from the CI log alone.
Each writer commits its own path, so a writer that loses the add/commit interleaving still has its own change to commit and does not observe 'nothing to commit'.
The test still requires that BOTH concurrent writers exit 0 through `run_git_write`.
The test still requires that BOTH commits are present in `git log`.
